findings.evidence: Proof bodies at L62-65, L72-74, L106-108, L115-117, L158-161, L168-171 are all `let _ : IsNoetherianRing H := Algebra.FiniteType.isNoetherianRing k H; unfold ...; exact PrimeSpectrum.<same lemma> (augmentationPoint k H)`. `grep -rn "CounitConnectedComponent" TauCeti/` returns no importer. `IsNoetherianRing` is a `Prop` class, so the instance fixed inside the wrappers is interchangeable with any other by proof irrelevance — the wrappers add no content.
findings.fix: Delete those eight and replace `[Algebra.FiniteType k H]` with `variable [IsNoetherianRing H]` (the file already imports `Mathlib.RingTheory.Spectrum.Prime.Noetherian` and `TauCeti.Topology.NoetherianSpace.ConnectedComponents`, so `LocallyConnectedSpace (PrimeSpectrum H)` is found by instance search and the general API applies verbatim). Keep only the genuinely new content, stated about `PrimeSpectrum.connectedComponentIdempotent (augmentationPoint k H)` and `PrimeSpectrum.connectedComponentIdeal (augmentationPoint k H)`: the counit-is-one lemma (L78), the ideal-below-the-counit-kernel lemma (L121), and the `Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ` factorization with its two simp lemmas (L130-151). Callers with `[Algebra.FiniteType k H]` supply `haveI := Algebra.FiniteType.isNoetherianRing k H` once; this also generalizes the results from finite type to Noetherian.
findings.issue: Eight declarations duplicate `PrimeSpectrum.*` from the same PR, specialized to `augmentationPoint k H` and adding nothing but a `letI : IsNoetherianRing H`: `counitConnectedComponentIdempotent` (L56 = `PrimeSpectrum.connectedComponentIdempotent`), `isIdempotentElem_counitConnectedComponentIdempotent` (L61), `basicOpen_counitConnectedComponentIdempotent` (L69), `counitConnectedComponentIdeal` (L97), `counitConnectedComponentIdeal_eq_span` (L103, which restates `connectedComponentIdeal_eq_span`, itself `rfl`), `zeroLocus_counitConnectedComponentIdeal` (L112), `primeSpectrumCounitConnectedComponentHomeomorph` (L155), `primeSpectrumCounitConnectedComponentHomeomorph_apply` (L163, restating a `rfl` lemma). No file in the repo imports this module, so there is no consumer earning the specialization.

summary: The general `PrimeSpectrum.connectedComponentIdempotent` API is new and reuses Mathlib correctly, but the bialgebra file is largely a parallel copy of it at one fixed point: eight of its twelve declarations restate the general ones with proofs of the form `unfold; exact <general lemma>`, and nothing in the repo consumes them.
